content.title: Celsius Doubled Its Market Share This Year. Why The Stock  Took a Dive.
content.summary: Celsius  posted triple-digit revenue growth, widened gross margins, and took a bigger slice of the energy-drink aisle in the third quarter.  For the quarter ended in September, Celsius posted revenue of $725 million, up 173% from a year ago, as the company’s widened portfolio kicked into gear.  Two years ago, Celsius held a 10% share in the energy-drink market.
